instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: For my own assembly work I use the first component on my left, then work right. When a group shares supplies, put them in the common tray.
context.task: Set out the red base and yellow cap for assembly.
context.observed_robot_action: Set the red base on the person's right and the cap on their left.

motion_options.A: Swap the two components so their order is reversed.
motion_options.B: Point at the selected arrangement and leave it in place.
